mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_query_feedback(feedback_code,query_id,knowledge_base_id,actor_user_id,rating,reason_code,comment,suggested_answer,status) VALUES(#{code},#{queryId},#{kb},#{actor},#{rating},#{reason},#{comment},#{suggestion},'NEW') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rating=VALUES(rating),reason_code=VALUES(reason_code),comment=VALUES(comment), suggested_answer=VALUES(suggested_answer),status='NEW',reviewer_user_id=NULL,review_note=NULL,reviewed_time=NULL,updated_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT f.id,f.feedback_code feedbackCode,f.query_id queryId,f.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, f.rating,f.reason_code reasonCode,f.comment,f.suggested_answer suggestedAnswer,f.status, f.review_note reviewNote,f.created_time createdTime,f.updated_time updatedTime FROM t_query_feedback f WHERE f.query_id=#{queryId} AND f.actor_user_id=#{actor}
SELECT query_id queryId,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,actor_user_id actorUserId FROM t_query_trace WHERE query_id=#{queryId}

SELECT f.id,f.feedback_code feedbackCode,f.query_id queryId,f.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, f.rating,f.reason_code reasonCode,f.comment,f.suggested_answer suggestedAnswer,f.status, f.review_note reviewNote,f.created_time createdTime,f.updated_time updatedTime, t.original_query question,t.answer FROM t_query_feedback f JOIN t_query_trace t ON t.query_id=f.query_id WHERE f.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND f.actor_user_id=#{actor} ORDER BY f.updated_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(status='NEW'),0) newCount, COALESCE(SUM(status='IN_REVIEW'),0) inReviewCount, COALESCE(SUM(status='ACTION_REQUIRED'),0) actionRequiredCount, COALESCE(SUM(status='RESOLVED'),0) resolvedCount, COALESCE(SUM(status='REJECTED'),0) rejectedCount, COALESCE(SUM(rating='HELPFUL'),0) helpfulCount, COALESCE(SUM(rating='UNHELPFUL'),0) unhelpfulCount FROM t_query_feedback WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
SELECT id,feedback_code feedbackCode,query_id queryId,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, actor_user_id actorUserId,status,rating FROM t_query_feedback WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_query_feedback SET status=#{status},reviewer_user_id=#{reviewer},review_note=#{note}, reviewed_time=NOW(),updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
